title: Sales By Customer exports name the Sales Type selection
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Customer is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. With both options selected, export the PDF and the CSV and read the filter line.
  2. Select only Part Sales and export both again.
  3. Select only Service Sales and export both again.
  4. Untick both options and click Export.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: both read "Sales Type: All Sales".
  • Step 2: both read "Sales Type: Part Sales only".
  • Step 3: both read "Sales Type: Service Sales only".
  • Step 4: "Empty export" shows and no file is made.

The Sales By Customer spec, version 21 (6 Oct 2026, S3-R7, S15-R10 and S18-R10), still makes a file with a "No sales" line when no option is selected. PRD version 8 (14 Oct 2026) is later and says Export shows "Empty export" and makes no file; this case follows the PRD, which we take as prevailing. The difference is on the product owner's question list.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-R9: “The filter line at the top of every PDF and CSV export of Sales By Customer reads "Sales Type: All Sales", "Sales Type: Part Sales only", or "Sales Type: Service Sales only". With no option selected, Export shows "Empty export" and makes no file.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
